objects.description: One step of a workflow, carrying the instruction whoever performs it works from.

fields.name: id
fields.description: Storage key, opaque to callers.

fields.name: code
fields.description: Stable human-readable handle such as WI-1, minted once and never edited.

fields.name: workflow_id
fields.description: The workflow that owns this step.

fields.name: draft_id
fields.description: The draft this row belongs to. Every row belongs to one.

fields.name: title
fields.description: The step in one line.

fields.name: description
fields.description: What doing it involves.

fields.name: ordinality
fields.description: Where it sits within its workflow.

fields.name: prompt
fields.description: The instruction handed to whoever or whatever performs this step.

fields.name: kind
fields.description: What the step is: fill a form, send a form, notify, say yes or no, route the answers of a form that was sent, run another workflow, or chat with an agent. Empty for a step that is only an instruction.

fields.name: role_id
fields.description: The one role that acts on this step, in the same draft. Empty when the agency itself takes the step; a send-form or route step is always the agency's.

fields.name: run_workflow_id
fields.description: The workflow a run-workflow step starts, in the same draft. Empty for every other kind.

fields.name: form_name
fields.description: What the form this step takes is called. Empty for a route or run-workflow step, which take none.

fields.name: questions
fields.description: The questions of the step's form, in the order they are asked: each a prompt, an answer type of yes_no, single_choice, multi_select, free_text, date, time, number, currency, photo or file (the forms module's ten), whether it is required, a helper line, the typed options or the named list they come from, and a fixed value for a question the step always answers the same way.

fields.name: tool
fields.description: The one tool the person acting on this step uses to do it, by name, such as market_ask: a step does one thing. A test of the step lets the person use that tool and nothing else. Only a step that a role acts on names one.

fields.name: recipient_role_id
fields.description: The role a send-form or notify step goes to, in the same draft. Empty means everyone in the order's group.

fields.name: sent_step_id
fields.description: The send-form step, in the same workflow, whose form a yes-or-no step answers or whose answers a route step sorts.

fields.name: routes
fields.description: A route step's rules: each route says whether all or any of its rules must match, the rules (a question of the sent form, an operator and a value), and the step in the same workflow it goes to.

fields.name: otherwise_step_id
fields.description: The step in the same workflow a route step goes to when no route matches. Empty means the next step.

fields.name: time_limit_minutes
fields.description: How many minutes the person this step waits on has to answer. Zero means the step waits as long as it takes. Only a fill-form or yes-or-no step that a role acts on can carry one.

fields.name: cancel_workflow_id
fields.description: The workflow, in the same draft, that runs when the time limit passes with no answer; its notify step tells the person. Required with a time limit, empty without one.

fields.name: agent_role_id
fields.description: The role, in the same draft, that a chat step chats with: the agent that answers the person. Empty for every other kind.

fields.name: topic
fields.description: What a chat step talks about; the agent steers back to it. Empty for every other kind.

fields.name: opening_line
fields.description: What a chat step says first. Empty for every other kind.

fields.name: prompts
fields.description: Up to three prompts a chat step offers the person to start with, each a short line. Empty for every other kind.

fields.name: tools
fields.description: The tools a chat step may call, as the plain names the manager picked them by; they are kept as written and not checked against any list. Empty for every other kind.

fields.name: start_workflow_ids
fields.description: The workflows, in the same draft, that a chat step may lead the person to; never the workflow that owns the step. Empty for every other kind.

fields.name: created_at
fields.description: When the step was written.

fields.name: last_updated
fields.description: When it last changed.

fields.name: deleted
fields.description: Whether it has been retired from every listing.

fields.description: The switch itself: whether somebody switched this capability on in this draft. What actually runs is this, or locked, or needed by a workflow step, plus whatever those require; the listing shows that as enabled.

fields.name: locked
fields.description: Whether this capability may never be switched off. The operator door is the only one.

fields.name: spec
fields.description: The declared shape this organization gives the capability: which object fills each of the module's roles, what this organization calls it, and which table it lands in. Empty unless the module declares a blueprint to validate it against. Carries no instance — a launch supplies that.

fields.name: settings
fields.description: The values this organization gives the capability's own settings, as one JSON object keyed by setting name. Empty means none given. Checked by the module itself at publish, and published and versioned with the draft.

fields.name: icon
fields.description: The key of the icon the app and the studio draw for this capability, from the fixed set both ship. Taken from the catalog; empty means the first letter of its name.

fields.name: mounts
fields.description: The names this organization gives the capability when it runs it more than once: a JSON list of name, key and optional icon. Empty means the one mount the capability has always run under. A key is the mount the capability's records live in and never changes; a name is what the organization calls it.

objects.description: What the agency commits to. Advisory when it only says so, enforced when it names an action, a condition and what happens on a breach.

fields.name: id
fields.description: Storage key, opaque to callers.

fields.name: code
fields.description: Stable human-readable handle such as C-1. Attachments reference it by this, because a row id does not survive publishing.

fields.name: draft_id
fields.description: The draft this row belongs to. Every row belongs to one.

fields.name: text
fields.description: The commitment itself, in plain words. The agent reads it in its role brief.

fields.name: action
fields.description: The permission catalogue action this control guards, such as payments.release. Empty means advisory.

fields.name: cond_field
fields.description: The argument of the guarded call the condition tests.

fields.name: cond_operator
fields.description: How the argument is compared: eq, ne, gt, gte, lt or lte.

fields.name: cond_value
fields.description: What the argument is compared with.

fields.name: on_breach
fields.description: What happens when the condition holds: block, hold_for_approval, flag or run_workflow.

fields.name: workflow_id
fields.description: The workflow a run_workflow outcome starts, in the same draft.

fields.name: severity
fields.description: How much a breach matters: low, medium or high.

fields.name: created_at
fields.description: When it was written.

fields.name: last_updated
fields.description: When it last changed.

fields.name: deleted
fields.description: Whether it has been retired from every listing.

indexes.name: code
indexes.description: Finds one by the handle its attachments quote.

indexes.name: draft
indexes.description: Every listing reads one draft's rows.

indexes.name: action
indexes.description: Reads the controls that guard one action.

objects.description: One place a control stands. None at all means it applies to the whole organization.

fields.name: id
fields.description: Storage key, opaque to callers.

fields.name: draft_id
fields.description: The draft this row belongs to. Every row belongs to one.

fields.name: control_code
fields.description: The control being attached, by its stable handle rather than its row id.

fields.name: target_type
fields.description: What kind of thing it is attached to.

fields.name: target_code
fields.description: The thing itself, by its stable handle.

fields.name: created_at
fields.description: When the attachment was made.

indexes.name: draft
indexes.description: Every listing reads one draft's rows.

indexes.name: control_code
indexes.description: Reads everywhere one control stands.

indexes.name: target
indexes.description: Reads every control that stands on one thing.

indexes.name: ctl_target_unique
indexes.description: Refuses a second link between one control and one thing in a draft, so two writers racing cannot both add it.

objects.description: Something the validation scan found wrong, and what stands between a draft and publishing.

fields.name: id
fields.description: Storage key, opaque to callers.

fields.name: draft_id
fields.description: The draft that was scanned.

fields.name: severity
fields.description: Whether this blocks publishing or only warns.

fields.name: message
fields.description: What is wrong, in words a reviewer can act on.

fields.name: entity_type
fields.description: What kind of thing the finding is about.

fields.name: entity_id
fields.description: The thing the finding is about.

fields.name: created_at
fields.description: When the scan that found it ran.

indexes.name: draft
indexes.description: Every listing reads one draft's findings, and the rescan deletes them the same way.

indexes.name: severity
indexes.description: The publish gate reads only the blocking ones.

objects.description: A frozen copy of the whole organization, and what anything in production actually runs from.

fields.name: id
fields.description: Storage key, opaque to callers.

fields.name: draft_id
fields.description: The draft this was published from.

fields.name: content_hash
fields.description: What was published, hashed, so republishing something unchanged can be refused.

fields.name: version
fields.description: The counter this publication took, and the key a caller names it by.

fields.name: tag
fields.description: The operator's own name for this publication, unique across all of them.

fields.name: channel
fields.description: Which live channel serves it — production, staging — or empty for one nothing runs from. At most one publication per channel.

fields.name: document
fields.description: The whole organization as published. Empty only for publications written before documents were kept.

fields.name: published_at
fields.description: When it was published.

fields.name: last_updated
fields.description: When its channel was last changed.

indexes.name: draft
indexes.description: Reads what one draft has published.

indexes.name: content_hash
indexes.description: Answers whether this exact content has been published before.

indexes.name: version
indexes.description: Reads the publications in order, and finds the one a caller named.

indexes.name: version_unique
indexes.description: Refuses a second publication at one version, so two operators publishing together cannot both take it.

indexes.name: channel
indexes.description: The production read: which publication serves this channel.

objects.description: The counter behind each stable handle, one row per kind of thing that has one.

fields.name: entity_type
fields.description: Which kind of thing this counter mints handles for.

fields.name: next_number
fields.description: The number the next handle of this kind will take.

objects.description: One figure an objective is judged by: what is measured, where it stands and where it should get to.

fields.name: id
fields.description: Storage key, opaque to callers.

fields.name: draft_id
fields.description: The draft this row belongs to. Every row belongs to one.

fields.name: objective_id
fields.description: The objective this measure belongs to, in the same draft.

fields.name: name
fields.description: What is measured, such as Suppliers posting prices. Two measures of one objective never share a name.

fields.name: current
fields.description: Where the figure stands now. Read by the console; the manager does not set it through the set tool.

fields.name: target
fields.description: Where the figure should get to, such as 40.

fields.name: unit
fields.description: What the figure counts, such as suppliers. Optional.

fields.name: status
fields.description: How the objective is doing against the target, in a word or two. Optional.

fields.name: created_at
fields.description: When the measure was first set.

fields.name: last_updated
fields.description: When it last changed.

fields.name: deleted
fields.description: Whether it has been retired from every listing.

indexes.name: draft
indexes.description: Every listing reads one draft's rows.

indexes.name: objective
indexes.description: Reads the measures of one objective, and backs its delete cascade.

objects.description: A named list a workflow keeps beside its steps: who adds rows to it and the form each row is added with.

fields.name: id
fields.description: Storage key, opaque to callers.

fields.name: code
fields.description: Stable human-readable handle such as RC-1, minted once and never edited. Rows quote it so they survive a new version.

fields.name: draft_id
fields.description: The draft this row belongs to. Every row belongs to one.

fields.name: workflow_id
fields.description: The workflow that keeps this record, in the same draft.

fields.name: name
fields.description: What the record is called, such as Payments.

fields.name: role_id
fields.description: The one role that adds rows, in the same draft.

fields.name: viewer_role_id
fields.description: The one role whose members each see their own row of the record, in the same draft. Empty when no role but the one that adds rows sees them.

fields.name: form_name
fields.description: What the form each row is added with is called.

fields.name: questions
fields.description: The questions of the form each row is added with, in the order they are asked.

fields.name: created_at
fields.description: When the record was written.

fields.name: last_updated
fields.description: When it last changed.

fields.name: deleted
fields.description: Whether it has been retired from every listing.

indexes.name: code
indexes.description: Finds a record by the handle its rows quote.

indexes.name: draft
indexes.description: Every listing reads one draft's rows.

objects.description: One row added to a record from the member app, kept in the agency and never copied into a new version.

fields.name: id
fields.description: Storage key, opaque to callers.

fields.name: draft_id
fields.description: The draft whose record this row was added to.

fields.name: record_id
fields.description: The record the row belongs to.

fields.name: record_code
fields.description: That record's handle, which stays the same in every later version.

fields.name: role_id
fields.description: The role the person adding the row acted as.

fields.name: added_by
fields.description: Who added the row, as the app names them.

fields.name: answers
fields.description: The answer to each question of the record's form, by the question's prompt.

fields.name: order_id
fields.description: The one group order the row was added from. Empty for a row that belongs to no order.

fields.name: replaces
fields.description: The row this one corrects. The replaced row stays, and reads as history.

fields.name: corrected_on
fields.description: When this row replaced the earlier one. Empty for a row that corrects nothing.

fields.name: send_key
fields.description: The step and run a workflow step sent this row for, written by the step's own send and by nothing else. Empty for every other row, including the ones kept from before the key existed.

fields.name: created_at
fields.description: When the row was added.

fields.name: last_updated
fields.description: When it last changed.

fields.name: deleted
fields.description: Whether it has been retired from every listing.

indexes.name: record
indexes.description: Reads the rows of one record.

indexes.name: record_code
indexes.description: Reads the rows of one record across versions.

indexes.name: record_order
indexes.description: Reads the rows of one record that belong to one group order.

indexes.name: send_key_unique
indexes.description: Refuses a second send of one step in one run, so two writers racing, in this process or another, cannot both add it. A retired row frees its step, and rows with no key, which include every row kept from before the key existed, are left out.

objects.description: One path through one workflow that the Test agent plays out, and whether it has passed on this draft.

fields.name: id
fields.description: Storage key, opaque to callers.

fields.name: draft_id
fields.description: The draft this scenario is written against. Every scenario belongs to one.

fields.name: name
fields.description: What the designer calls it.

fields.name: summary
fields.description: What it tries, in a sentence or two.

fields.name: workflow_id
fields.description: The workflow it mirrors, in the same draft. Its steps are the scenario's blocks and the rules it shows are the ones attached to that workflow.

fields.name: result
fields.description: Where the scenario stands on this draft: not run yet, or the result of its last run. Anything but passed blocks publishing, and a change to what it uses sends it back to not run yet.

fields.name: last_run_id
fields.description: The test run that set the result. Empty while the scenario has not run on this draft.

fields.name: thens
fields.description: The Then line of each block, as a list of step_id and then: what the Test agent judges against the test copy once that step has been played. A step with no entry has no Then line.

fields.name: created_at
fields.description: When the scenario was written.

fields.name: last_updated
fields.description: When it last changed.

indexes.name: draft
indexes.description: Every listing reads one draft's rows.

indexes.name: workflow
indexes.description: Reads the scenarios that mirror one workflow.

objects.description: Someone the Test agent plays in one scenario: a name, unique within the scenario, and the agency role they hold.

fields.name: id
fields.description: Storage key, opaque to callers.

fields.name: scenario_id
fields.description: The scenario this actor plays in.

fields.name: draft_id
fields.description: The draft this row belongs to.

fields.name: name
fields.description: What the script calls them, such as Farmer 1. Unique within the scenario.

fields.name: kind
fields.description: A person holding an agency role, one of the agency's agents, or the System. Only role actors are written by a caller; the agents and the System are always present and read only.

fields.name: role_id
fields.description: The agency role they hold, in the same draft.

fields.name: ordinality
fields.description: The order the actors were added in; the first actor holding a role plays the steps of that role.

fields.name: created_at
fields.description: When the actor was added.

fields.name: last_updated
fields.description: When it last changed.

indexes.name: scenario
indexes.description: Reads the actors of one scenario.

indexes.name: draft
indexes.description: Every listing reads one draft's rows.

indexes.name: role
indexes.description: Answers which scenarios have an actor of one role.

objects.description: A value fixed for one field of one step in one scenario. A field with no row is Free and the Test agent chooses.

fields.name: id
fields.description: Storage key, opaque to callers.

fields.name: scenario_id
fields.description: The scenario this value is fixed in.

fields.name: draft_id
fields.description: The draft this row belongs to.

fields.name: step_id
fields.description: The step of the scenario's workflow it is fixed on.

fields.name: field
fields.description: The prompt of the question on that step's form.

fields.name: value
fields.description: What the Test agent answers.

fields.name: created_at
fields.description: When it was fixed.

fields.name: last_updated
fields.description: When it last changed.

indexes.name: scenario
indexes.description: Reads the fixed values of one scenario.

indexes.name: draft
indexes.description: Every listing reads one draft's rows.

objects.description: One run of one scenario: when it ran, on which version of the draft, how it ended, what transpired step by step and the tokens it used. Kept until removed and never carried into a publication.

fields.name: id
fields.description: Storage key, opaque to callers.

fields.name: scenario_id
fields.description: The scenario that ran.

fields.name: draft_id
fields.description: The draft it ran on.

fields.name: draft_version
fields.description: A hash of the draft's content when the run began, so a report names the version it tested.

fields.name: result
fields.description: How the run stands: waiting for a free place under the hub's Scenarios at once setting, running, or how it ended.

fields.name: stop_reason
fields.description: Why a stopped run stopped, such as Budget reached.

fields.name: tokens
fields.description: The tokens the whole run used.

fields.name: steps
fields.description: What transpired, in order: for each step who acted, who played it (the Test agent and the kind of step it played), what they did, what the agency recorded, the step, the rules checked and whether they held, the tokens used, whether a wait was acted out, and for a failure what was expected and what was found.

fields.name: stored
fields.description: The records the run left in the test copy, each as the record's name, what it holds and how many rows it holds.

fields.name: trail
fields.description: Every line the run wrote to the test copies, oldest first, each naming the step that caused it, the module and the endpoint.

fields.name: token_budget
fields.description: The tokens-per-test limit the run was started under. 0 means none.

fields.name: running_step
fields.description: The id of the step in progress. Empty once the run has ended.

fields.name: queued_at
fields.description: When the run was pressed. Runs past the Scenarios at once setting wait and start in this order, and a restart keeps it.

fields.name: started_at
fields.description: When the run began to run. Empty while it waits.

fields.name: finished_at
fields.description: When it ended. Empty while it runs.

indexes.name: scenario
indexes.description: Reads the runs of one scenario.

indexes.name: draft
indexes.description: Every listing reads one draft's rows.

objects.description: One run of the AI reviewers over one draft: who pressed it, when it began and ended, the review it read first and the tokens all the parts spent. Every review is kept with the draft and never carried into a publication.

fields.name: id
fields.description: Storage key, opaque to callers.

fields.name: draft_id
fields.description: The draft that was read.

fields.name: status
fields.description: Where the run stands: running while any part is still being read, then done, or failed.

fields.name: previous_review_id
fields.description: The review this run read first. Empty for the first run on a draft.

fields.name: started_by
fields.description: The person who pressed Run review.

fields.name: running
fields.description: True from the start of a run until its last part is recorded. The unique index on it lets one review of a draft hold it.

fields.name: started_at
fields.description: When the run began.

fields.name: finished_at
fields.description: When every part had finished. Empty while it runs.

fields.name: tokens
fields.description: The total tokens spent across the parts.

indexes.name: draft
indexes.description: Reads the reviews of one draft, the latest among them.

indexes.name: running_unique
indexes.description: Refuses a second running review of one draft, so two starts at once cannot both pass.

objects.description: One reviewer's part of a review: the part it read, how it stands, the two sentences it wrote and the tokens it spent. A review has one for each part, five where the agency has no objectives.

fields.name: id
fields.description: Storage key, opaque to callers.

fields.name: review_id
fields.description: The review this part belongs to.

fields.name: area
fields.description: The part of the draft the reviewer reads.

fields.name: status
fields.description: Whether the reviewer is still reading, has finished, or could not finish.

fields.name: failure_reason
fields.description: The sentence shown on a Failed tab.

fields.name: summary
fields.description: The two sentences at the top of the tab.

fields.name: tokens
fields.description: The tokens this reviewer spent.

indexes.name: review
indexes.description: Reads the parts of one review.

objects.description: One suggestion a reviewer made: what it noticed, what Apply would run, what the designer did with it and the reviewer's judgement of whether the problem is still there.

fields.name: id
fields.description: Storage key, opaque to callers.

fields.name: review_id
fields.description: The review this finding came from.

fields.name: area_id
fields.description: The part of that review it came from.

fields.name: ordinal
fields.description: Its place in the reviewer's list for that part, counting from 1. Findings are read back in this order.

fields.name: title
fields.description: The line the designer reads, such as Describe Farmer R-47.

fields.name: detail
fields.description: The sentence under the title.

fields.name: tool
fields.description: The agency tool Apply runs. Empty when the finding only advises.

fields.name: arguments
fields.description: What Apply passes to that tool, as an object.

fields.name: then_steps
fields.description: The further steps Apply runs after the tool, each as a tool and its arguments, in order.

fields.name: status
fields.description: What the designer did: still open, applied, or dismissed.

fields.name: fate
fields.description: The reviewer's judgement of the problem: new, fixed, still open, or withdrawn.

fields.name: fate_reason
fields.description: Why, in one sentence.

fields.name: carried_from_id
fields.description: The earlier finding this one answers. Empty for a new one.

indexes.name: review
indexes.description: Reads the findings of one review.

objects.description: A note the designer wrote on one finding. The next review reads it.

fields.name: id
fields.description: Storage key, opaque to callers.

fields.name: finding_id
fields.description: The finding it is on.

fields.name: author
fields.description: Who wrote it.

fields.name: body
fields.description: The text.

fields.name: created_at
fields.description: When it was written.

indexes.name: finding
indexes.description: Reads the comments on one finding.
